name: 84050 · Morgan, UT
findings: ZIP 84050 (Morgan) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84050 (Morgan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84050 (Morgan) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
